affected_predicate.description: Exactly the three latest-followed accounts remain followed and every other listed account is unfollowed.

competing_trace_defects.description: The trajectory begins modifying accounts based on unsupported and changing assumptions about whether list position represents follow recency; the visible list provides no recency metadata.
The agent clicks alex again after alex already displays Follow, visibly toggling the account back to Following and undoing prior progress.

chains.rationale: At reuse step 42, the repeated top-row click changes openCompany from Following to Follow even though the stated action intent names olivia. The trace never restores openCompany, but the supplied UI does not establish which accounts are the latest three, so whether this specific transition harmed the task predicate is unknown. By the last observable step, only openUniversity and frank display Following, so the requirement to retain exactly three accounts is visibly unsatisfied. Independent earlier defects include unsupported recency-order assumptions and re-following alex by clicking an already-Follow button.

summary: The reuse target visibly acts on openCompany rather than its stated olivia target, but the trace does not reveal which accounts are the latest three, so its contribution to the task predicate remains unknown. The terminal UI visibly retains only two followed accounts, while earlier independent recency-assumption and state-toggle defects are observable.
